title: A Survey Instrument to Assess Students' AI and Generative AI Knowledge
abstract: arXiv:2608.21391v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In this research-to-practice paper we present a survey that can be used to assess students' AI knowledge. As the use of artificial intelligence (AI), including generative artificial intelligence (GenAI), has proliferated, so has the need to educate students about the topic. A range of AI literacy frameworks have been proposed, outlining the essential knowledge that students should have. Alongside, different ways of assessing AI knowledge have been developed. As yet, there is a lack of assessment instruments capable of evaluating multiple forms of student knowledge, including technical concepts, practical applications, and ethical concerns about AI use. In this article, we present a study implementing a comprehensive instrument to assess AI knowledge. The instrument combines measures from multiple scales to capture a range of literacy features and actual knowledge. We implemented the instrument in a higher education setting to assess it

translated_title: 评估学生AI与生成式AI知识的调查工具
translated_abstract: 在这篇研究到实践的论文中，我们提出了一项可用于评估学生AI知识的调查。随着人工智能（AI）包括生成式人工智能（GenAI）的使用激增，教育学生了解该主题的需求也随之增加。已经提出了各种AI素养框架，概述了学生应具备的基本知识。同时，也开发了不同的AI知识评估方法。然而，目前仍缺乏能够评估学生多种形式知识的评估工具，包括技术概念、实际应用以及对AI使用的伦理关切。在本文中，我们介绍了一项实施综合工具以评估AI知识的研究。该工具结合了多个量表的测量，以捕捉一系列素养特征和实际知识。我们在高等教育环境中实施了该工具以对其进行评估。
tldr: 本文提出并验证了一个综合调查工具，能够同时评估学生在AI和生成式AI方面的技术概念、实际应用和伦理知识。
en_tdlr: This paper presents and validates a comprehensive survey instrument that assesses students' knowledge of AI and generative AI across technical concepts, practical applications, and ethical concerns.
